text: Prepared a read-only production-objective probe from the verified OASIS11 selected-control fine-start checkpoint (serial23), as D01 replay infrastructure for D02. Frozen before acquired-image derivative outcomes in objective-probe-pilot-v1; numerical source 59d06ff2d74eed1bed7f9b31027f8a62cefca5c8c56657f386d4d3a16a1fc129. Probe calls the actual objective initialization, frozen candidate evaluator and production gradient; perturbations use actual paired integration, residual composition and image interpolation. Declared three label-independent directions (tapered translation, smooth wave, normalized negative gradient), epsilons .5/.2/.1/.05/.02/.01/.005/.002 mm, expected initial loss tolerance 1e-12, derivative criterion minimum symmetric relative error <=.005 with a three-point decreasing-error region (existing synthetic test criterion). This examines the frozen objective before accumulated smoothing; regularization, other cases/scales/order/mixed grids remain separate. New probe tests pass 2 JVM +2 JS, observer6 JVM pass, runner compiles. Full engine regression had 14/15 pass and one existing 30-second timeout at ~41 seconds during concurrent diagnostics; retain failure and rerun when quieter. No ordinary optimizer formula or policy changed. D01/D02 remain incomplete, no qualification claim.
